title: About
description: Information about the user, the user's Drive, and system capabilities.

appInstalled.description: Whether the user has installed the requesting app.

canCreateDrives.description: Whether the user can create shared drives.

driveThemes.description: A list of themes that are supported for shared drives.

backgroundImageLink.description: A link to this theme's background image.

colorRgb.description: The color of this theme as an RGB hex string.

exportFormats.description: A map of source MIME type to possible targets for all supported exports.

folderColorPalette.description: The currently supported folder colors as RGB hex strings.

importFormats.description: A map of source MIME type to possible targets for all supported imports.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"drive#about"`.

maxImportSizes.description: A map of maximum import sizes by MIME type, in bytes.

maxUploadSize.description: The maximum upload size in bytes.

storageQuota.description: The user's storage quota limits and usage. All fields are measured in bytes.

limit.description: The usage limit, if applicable. This will not be present if the user has unlimited storage.

usage.description: The total usage across all services.

usageInDrive.description: The usage by all files in Google Drive.

usageInDriveTrash.description: The usage by trashed files in Google Drive.

displayName.description: Output only. A plain text displayable name for this user.

emailAddress.description: Output only. The email address of the user. This may not be present in certain contexts if the user has not made their email address visible to the requester.

kind.description: Output only. Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"drive#user"`.

me.description: Output only. Whether this user is the requesting user.

permissionId.description: Output only. The user's ID as visible in Permission resources.

photoLink.description: Output only. A link to the user's profile photo, if available.
